# Live Eye: Voice. Talk on your stream

![Live Eye: Voice. Talk on your stream](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/live-eye-voice.jpg)

Streamers can now use a microphone on the Live Eye. It is off until you turn it on in the Stream settings, and the mic beside LIVE in your inventory shows when you are being heard.

TVs on the train now play the live stream's sound. A TV you wear or hold plays flat; a placed TV plays from where it stands and fades with distance, further for bigger screens.

Lots of new settings can be found to enable or disable, to set things up how you like, in Options, Dungeon Train, Stream. Including muting specific streamers. Streamers can be reported in game, or from the browser live stream, for harassment or inappropriate language.

Only select accounts will be able to talk on the official Twitch. Only select accounts will reach kids.

[AshSeven](https://twitch.tv/ashseven7) is on track to be the first person ever to hit the Everything Burrito advancement, for completing every other advancement tab, on 14 November 2026 at 07:00 UTC (<t:1794639600:F> in your time zone). Put his livestream in your calendar!

**New Feature ×3 · Community ×2 · Compatibility ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1632.0

**More photo albums for supporters**

Anyone who has supported the game can now keep more than one photo album: one extra for any donation, and 10 for every A$10. Once your first album is full, an album you find on the train is your newest album half the time, and one of your full albums the rest of the time. A crafted album is always your newest one.

- Your photo album now follows you to every computer you play on

### 0.1631.0

**Essential Tweaks and more mods count for fair play**

Running Essential Tweaks alongside Essential no longer puts your run in Free Play. A batch of recently approved mods now also count offline, from your very first launch.

- Essential Tweaks approved for fair play
- Armor Visibility now counts, it was approved under the wrong name before
- Shoulder Surfing, Legendary Tooltips, Just Enough Characters, Armor HUD, Cubes Without Borders, Explosive Enhancement, Weapon Master and Cinematic Interactions are approved offline too

### 0.1630.0

**Whitelist approval notes**

When a mod you suggested for the whitelist, or commented on, gets approved, a note now lands in your inbox on the main menu. The inbox window also shows notes sent to you outside of Discord, which it used to miss.

- Suggested a mod and it got approved? You will hear about it on the main menu.
- Inbox notes from Dungeon Train itself now show up in the window instead of a connection error.

### 0.1628.0

**Finished stories no longer repeat in new worlds**

Once you've read a narrative story to the end, lecterns stop offering it, in any world, until you've finished every other story. Your reading now carries across worlds, so each new world brings you closer to finishing the stories and to discovering player-written ones.

- A finished story stays out of lecterns until every story is finished
- Finishing a story in one world unlocks its follow-up stories in every world
- Player-written stories unlock based on how much you've read across all worlds
- Re-read stories now start at letter 1 and continue in order

### 0.1627.0

**Faster update checks behind the scenes**

Updates now move through testing faster, because changes waiting to go in no longer trip over each other.

### 0.1626.0

Lush caves inside some of the mountains along the line were strangely empty. They now fill with axolotls, glow squid, fish, bats and the usual cave monsters, like lush caves anywhere else.
